accepted_contract: One lock-serialized provider observation with schema version, producer boot identity, monotonic revision, observation time, freshness, stable state episode and explicit evidence.
One authenticated Gateway envelope with actor/execution and before/after fenced operation, transition, stream session, control generation and actor lease correlation.
One process-wide serialized Android projection owner with request ordinals and retired-boot rejection within and across producer boots.
A distinct local retained transport generation owned by RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator.
A non-resetting episode liveness deadline converging to READY, IDLE, RECOVERY_REQUIRED or UNAVAILABLE.
Events cannot independently prove readiness and missing game evidence cannot be replaced with the expected game.
Known-live local transport survives unknown, malformed, mismatched or unavailable remote game evidence.
Recovery is exact-fenced, never automatic merely from RECOVERY_REQUIRED, and is verified by the next new authorized Play attempt.
Parent and child use one contract without a parent-only health dependency.
All Activity, Game, transition, presentation and termination consumers migrate without an alternate truth path.
